page_title: BUR 0-2 WHU | Burnley v West Ham 07/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Darren England is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+6' Martin Dubravka makes a good save! Axel Disasi (West Ham) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a low shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
90+6' Adama Traore almost found himself in a promising position after Pablo (West Ham) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
90+5' Darren England interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Maxime Esteve (Burnley).
90+2' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Adama Traore (West Ham) will replace Crysencio Summerville.
90+2' Nuno Espirito Santo has decided to substitute Jarrod Bowen and he is replaced by Kyle Walker-Peters (West Ham).
90+1' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Armando Broja (Burnley) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
86' Loum Tchaouna (Burnley) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
84' Yellow card. Josh Laurent (Burnley) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.

80' An accurate pass to the edge of the box is well taken by Mateus Fernandes (West Ham), whose instinctive shot towards goal flashes inches wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.
80' Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
79' We are about to witness a subsitution. Armando Broja (Burnley) for Lesley Ugochukwu.
79' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. El Hadji Malick Diouf will be replaced by Oliver Scarles (West Ham).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo (West Ham) replaces Taty Castellanos.
76' Looks like Aaron Wan-Bissaka (West Ham) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
76' Tempers flare after a clattering challenge by Bashir Humphreys (Burnley), who receives a yellow card from the referee. It could have been worse for him!
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 17:4.
73' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Mads Hermansen intercepts the ball.
70' Taty Castellanos (West Ham) is penalised for a foul. Darren England had a clear view and blows his whistle.
69' Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the area, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post. The ball goes out of play and West Ham will have a goal kick.
67' Substitution. Lyle Foster (Burnley) has come on for Zian Flemming.
67' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Marcus Edwards as he is replaced by Loum Tchaouna (Burnley).
66' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
66' Scott Parker has decided to make a change. Jacob Bruun Larsen (Burnley) replaces Jaidon Anthony.

66' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) dribbled past his opponents before finding himself in a great position to strike. His attempt from just outside of the box went towards the right side of the goal, but it wasn't dangerous and Mads Hermansen made a comfortable save.
65' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) takes the free kick but it is cleared by the first defender.
63' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Crysencio Summerville.
62' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) steps up to take a free kick and sends it in, but the opposition's defence is alert and clears the ball to safety.
61' A clumsy foul by Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) and Darren England blows his whistle.
60' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Darren England blows his whistle for an infringement.

59' Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) has the goal in his sights after a good run to the edge of the box, but his weak effort flies high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.

57' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) wasted a huge opportunity! The fans already began to celebrate as he produced a low shot from the edge of the box after a brilliant solo effort. The ball went towards the middle of the goal, but Martin Dubravka made an astonishing save!
57' The referee signals a substitution. Freddie Potts (West Ham) is brought on as a substitute for Callum Wilson.
56' Darren England blows the whistle, Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) is penalised for a foul.
55' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) receives a good pass and from just outside the box he unleashes a promising strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
54' The corner is swung in but Burnley can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
54' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jaidon Anthony (Burnley). Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.

52' Zian Flemming (Burnley) rises above the opponent's defence and heads a precise cross towards the middle of the goal. His effort, however, is blocked by Mads Hermansen, who pulls off a comfortable save!
52' The referee awards a corner and Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) goes over to take it.
52' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes out of play and Burnley have been awarded a corner kick.
51' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked.
51' Kyle Walker (Burnley) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
50' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) plays a through ball inside the box, but it's too strong and Martin Dubravka comes off his line to intercept.
49' The resulting set piece from Burnley is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

49' Mads Hermansen makes a brilliant save! Marcus Edwards (Burnley) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from just outside of the box. His effort goes towards the bottom right corner but is saved by the keeper! The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Burnley.

47' Zian Flemming (Burnley) latched on to a cross inside the six-yard box and headed at goal. If it wasn't for one of the defenders making a save on the goal line, he would have been celebrating a goal now.
46' Callum Wilson (West Ham) dribbles into the box, but Martin Dubravka is quick enough to come off his line and stop him.
46' Scott Parker has made a change at the break. Josh Laurent has come on in place of Florentino (Burnley).
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+2' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) is about to take a corner kick.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mads Hermansen, who smothers the ball.
44' Darren England blows for a foul after Mateus Fernandes (West Ham) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
42' Burnley can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

42' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Burnley are awarded a corner kick.
41' Darren England shows the yellow card to El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) for a heavy challenge.

40' What a chance that is! Marcus Edwards (Burnley) finds himself unmarked in a promising position after receiving a cross on the edge of the box and his attempt sails a whisker wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
39' The resulting set piece is taken by Zian Flemming (Burnley). His long cannonball into the middle ends up in the goalkeeper’s hands.
38' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren England blows for a foul. Burnley earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
37' Burnley force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
37' Marcus Edwards (Burnley) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
35' A snap shot from distance by Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) after a precise pass is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
33' Lesley Ugochukwu (Burnley) dribbles his way to the edge of the box and drills a shot towards the middle of the goal, but Mads Hermansen is equal to the effort and makes a good save.
32' Jaidon Anthony (Burnley) cracks a first-time shot from inside the box, but it flies way wide of the left post.
28' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Burnley.

26' 0 - 2 Goal! El Hadji Malick Diouf swings the ball deep into the box and finds Taty Castellanos (West Ham) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the bottom right corner. 0:2.
25' Zian Flemming (Burnley) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
24' Florentino (Burnley) is booked.
22' Hannibal Mejbri (Burnley) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for West Ham.
20' Darren England blows his whistle after Florentino (Burnley) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball.
18' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
18' A cross from Bashir Humphreys (Burnley) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
16' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

13' 0 - 1 Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) finishes his beautiful individual effort with a superb strike from inside the box. Martin Dubravka is just a bystander as the ball flies low into the middle of the goal. The score is 0:1.
12' El Hadji Malick Diouf (West Ham) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
11' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for West Ham.
10' Callum Wilson (West Ham) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. West Ham have a corner.
5' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball goes out of play and Burnley will have a goal kick.
5' Crysencio Summerville (West Ham) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
3' The ball is cleared after Jarrod Bowen (West Ham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
1' The first half has started.
Burnley will kick-off.
